description: Mesh a design with GD Structured or GD Unstructured. Standard CGNS export by default; explicit GD CGNS, .msh or OpenFOAM exports. Memory-limited compute: usually a few minutes and under 2 credits; estimate_cost gives the figure. Not needed when an owned mesh for the same geometry and settings already exists and the user accepts reuse. Create a new mesh job per request with a fresh idempotency key. Reuse old compute only when the user requests or accepts reuse. Re-meshing a surface within 24 hours is a retry; on retry_not_allowed ask the user. Same-job transport recovery keeps its key; a reviewed new attempt uses reviewed_job_id and a fresh key. Default retry_policy=review stops after one full attempt; do not silently retry a completed or failed mesh. A verified count miss returns awaiting_decision; report evidence and use review_job to accept/discard, or obtain explicit authority before new compute. Use this job's mesh_cgns for views. For a generic view use view_mesh or the default interactive 3D browser viewer (cell surfaces, quality metrics, true slices); PNGs or 2D sections alone are insufficient. Mesh an owned ready geometry artifact. Structured requests select engine=structured; generic unstructured requests prefer engine=octree_prism when configured; export_formats is independent of the engine; default [cgns] is Standard CGNS NGON/NFACE; preserve an explicit choice. End your reply with get_job's viewer_url, opened in the chat's browser; use mesh_exports only when the user asks for a mesh file. All engines default to ±30% cell-count tolerance; omit cell_count_tolerance unless the user asks for another. get_request_schema(mesh) has the full schema; inspect_mesh_geometry gives bounds and assessed component IDs when available. Before an octree mesh, check_geometry finds holes and other surface problems, and plan_mesh shows the sizes, predicted cells and any refusal, without compute. Solid-only uses structured.workflow=solid and flow_region={kind: solid, component_id: inspected ID}; no fluid box is required. Never switch solid/internal/external/CHT intent to bypass a failure. Ask about consequential preferences such as stair_step/cut_cell and boundary layers; otherwise use disclosed best judgment. For an external octree mesh, state intent in octree_prism.controls (flow, wake, layers) and leave sizes out unless the user gives them: the mesher resolves the rest from the geometry, and other octree fields override what it resolves. get_mesh_controls lists surface, volume/wake, layer, topology and boundary settings. Structured has no prism layers; octree controls.boundary_layer.layers=0 and openfoam.n_prism_layers=0 disable layers. For an already-enclosed fluid STL or STEP surface, use octree_prism.workflow=internal with explicit geometry bounds, minimum/maximum spacing and at least one prism layer; cht_ports are points near flat inlet/outlet faces. It meshes only the enclosed fluid, keeping its boundary; mrf_zones and named_surfaces (fluid_domain_<name>) work; its sizes set the cell count, not target_cells. Optional internal_small_feature_size (m) removes tiny disconnected shells, solid islands included; it simplifies the geometry, so omit it unless requested or accepted, and disclose it. A disconnected fluid source is refused unless internal_component_policy=largest_connected, which keeps the largest volume and reports excluded pockets (nested cavities or equal volumes are refused). Octree CHT needs the STEP's actual material names and an explicit n_prism_layers: 0 for the octree CHT route, more for prism layers on the coolant walls (a fluid region named with fluid or coolant, and cht_ports near the inlet and outlet; sizes are absolute). Meshing admission is memory limited. Record assumptions in decision_context. At most 50 million cells. Use artifact summaries to inspect patches/zones before simulation. Meshing jobs per person are limited; a further one waits, and its queue.message says why: tell the user rather than resubmitting. Returns a job ID; may incur compute charges.

ambient_name.description: External CHT: region name of the fluid round the solids in the box.

component_id.description: Native profile component ID for internal fluid or solid-only meshing; never infer one from a display name.

kind.description: external: fluid outside bodies; internal: a selected fluid volume; solid: a selected closed component's material, no fluid.

NamedSurface.description: A wall part, uploaded as its own STL in the surface's units, for per-part sizes, layers, wakes and patches.

name.description: The part's name in controls and the mesh's wall patch name.

first_height.description: First layer height in metres. Give this or y_plus; with neither the stack is sized for the core cells.

gap_compression.description: In narrow passages shrink the stack to fit, keeping its layer count, instead of dropping layers.

layers.description: Prism layers; 0 for none (inviscid or wall-function walls).

y_plus.description: Target first-cell y+; needs flow.speed. A requested y+ is not an achieved one.

OctreeControls.description: Meshing intent: the mesher sizes everything left out for the request's target_cells.

exact_count.description: When the user states a cell count, probe the topology to land within 10% of it. Rebuilds need retry_policy=automatic, else the first passing mesh is kept and its count reported.

surfaces.description: Size and layer overrides per named surface or glob such as wheel_*.

OctreeDomain.description: Body lengths from the body (unset ones as "standard"; side 0 touches it), or absolute corners in metres.

bottom.description: Below the body when there is no ground; default as top.

angle_of_attack.description: Degrees, turning the stream from direction towards up. The domain stays on the body axes; the wake follows the stream.

contact_plinth.description: Tyres on the ground: cut them just above it and extrude a vertical plinth instead of the tangential wedge.

farfield.description: inlet_outlet: velocity inlet upstream, pressure outlet downstream, symmetry elsewhere. freestream: far-field patches all round (free flight at any angle); a ground stays a moving wall.

ground.description: "none": free stream all round; "body_min": a moving-wall ground at the lowest point of the body (vehicles); a number: the ground at that up-coordinate in metres.

kinematic_viscosity.description: m^2/s, for y_plus sizing; air by default.

sideslip.description: Degrees, turning the stream towards the side axis.

speed.description: Free-stream speed in m/s; sizes the first layer from boundary_layer.y_plus.

up.description: Up axis, different from the direction's axis.

OctreePartWake.description: A wake behind named parts (mirrors, wheels, a hub), along the stream.

size.description: Cell size in metres; default the body wake's.

OctreePrismOptions.description: GD Unstructured. Sizing, units, layers and rotating zones: get_mesh_controls or get_tool_schema. Unknown fields and quality-gate overrides are rejected.

controls.description: Meshing intent (flow, wake, layers, sizes) for an external mesh; the mesher resolves every field left out as the development meshes were validated. Fields beside it override that: set them only for a value the user asked for.

named_surfaces.description: Wall parts, each an uploaded STL in the surface's units, named for controls.surfaces, wake parts and around regions; each becomes a wall patch. For a STEP: its preview's surfaces (omit: solids are named).

retry_authorization_reason.description: Who authorized automatic retries (the user or a delegated agent); needed for retry_policy=automatic.

retry_policy.description: review: stop before another full or memory-escalated attempt, keeping out-of-tolerance results for a decision. automatic: the authorized, bounded retry budget, within the credential's retry allowance.

OctreeRegion.description:
Cells inside are no larger than size: a box (minimum and maximum, or center and lengths,
rotated by x_axis and y_axis), cylinder (start, end, radius), sphere (center, radius)
or around named surfaces (surfaces, distance).

distance.description: An around region's reach from its surfaces, in metres.

inner_radius.description: An annulus round a hub, or a spherical shell.

lengths.description: Full box lengths along x_axis, y_axis and their cross product.

surfaces.description: Named surfaces for an around region.

OctreeRotatingZone.description: A cylindrical rotating (MRF) cell zone, written to the mesh.

angular_velocity.description: rad/s, when rpm is not given.

size.description: Cell size inside the zone in metres; default none.

OctreeShell.description: Distance from the whole body, with an independently extended downstream reach.

distance.description: Surface distance in body lengths, NOT metres. List shells nearest first.

downstream.description: Downstream reach over surface distance: 1 is an equal-distance shell; 4 reaches four times farther downstream along controls.flow.direction.

size.description: Cell size in metres; omit for target-count sizing. Outer shells default to 2, 4, 8... times the surface size.

chord_tolerance.description: Adaptive sizing: most wall sag from the CAD per edge, in metres. Can take the mesh past target_cells; plan_mesh says when.

close_gaps.description: Close fluid gaps under this many first-layer heights. Changes the geometry: only for an explicit simplification, disclosed.

curvature_angle.description: Most surface turning per adaptive edge, in degrees; leave out for the service's setting (18 by default).

fidelity.description: high: sharp edges snapped to the wall and creases split, so creased walls warp far less; up to ~40% slower. exact: high plus chord_tolerance 0.0002 x body length. standard (old name default): creases chamfered; faster.

max_deviation.description: Allowed wall-to-CAD p95 deviation in metres; default two surface sizes.

min_size.description: Smallest curvature-driven edge in metres; default size / 8.

preparation.description: auto: feature-preserving remesh for clean solids, a voxel wrap for dirty CAD; preserve or wrap force one route.

size.description: Wall edge length in metres (with adaptive sizing, the largest). Leave out to size the wall for target_cells; set it only when the user fixes one.

sizing.description: adaptive: refined for curvature, sharp edges, narrow gaps and thin walls down to min_size; uniform: one edge length.

layers.description: Most prism layers on these surfaces; 0 for none.

size.description: Largest wall edge on these surfaces, in metres; refines the automatic size there, never coarsens it.

domain.description: Wind-tunnel size in body lengths upstream/downstream/side/top (compact 3/6/2/2, standard 5/10/4/4, large 8/16/6/6), or an explicit domain.

growth.description: How quickly cells coarsen away from the body.

max_size.description: Largest far-field cell in metres; default from the domain size.

shells.description: Nested whole-body surface-distance regions, external flow only; needs mesh_controls_version 2. Count calibration may scale their sizes.

length.description: Downstream extent in body lengths, along the stream.

levels.description: Nested levels, each twice as long with twice the cell size (2: a near and a far wake).

size.description: Near-wake cell size in metres; default twice the surface size. Leave out to size the wake for target_cells.

spread.description: Widening: each side moves out by spread per unit length (0.1: +10% of the length each side at the end).

OpenFoamOptions.description: engine=openfoam. Sizing and quality fields: get_mesh_controls(engine=openfoam) or get_tool_schema; unknown fields are rejected.

input_unit.description: Surface coordinate units; domain bounds and spacing are always in metres.

n_prism_layers.description: Requested layers; 0 disables layers. Achieved layers/coverage must be checked after meshing.

retry_authorization_reason.description: Who authorized automatic retries (the user or a delegated agent); needed for retry_policy=automatic.

retry_policy.description: review: stop before another full mesh attempt. automatic: the authorized, bounded max_remesh_iterations, within the credential's retry allowance.

StructuredInternalSurface.description: Two-sided rectangular pressure-jump selection, never an exterior wall.

StructuredOptions.description: engine=structured. Sizing and quality fields: get_mesh_controls(engine=structured) or get_tool_schema; unknown fields are rejected.

adaptive_refinement.description: CAD assemblies and internal stair-step: resolve sampled thin features and tight passages, coarser bulk elsewhere. Sizing alone does not set wall-model accuracy.

input_unit.description: Derive from artifact metadata; required for uploads without declared units.

mesh_type.description: Ask about surface fidelity; stair_step is the disclosed default. Neither option extrudes prism layers.

retry_authorization_reason.description: Who authorized automatic retries (the user or a delegated agent); needed for retry_policy=automatic.

retry_policy.description: review: stop before another full target-count attempt. automatic: the authorized, bounded max_target_iterations, within the credential's retry allowance.

decision_context.description: User intent and declared assumptions, retained with the owned job request.

engine.description: structured: Cartesian; octree_prism: native octree/polyhedral with prism layers, for a generic unstructured request; openfoam: legacy. Keep a method the user named. Formats are export_formats.

export_formats.description: Delivered formats, any engine; the first is the primary download. cgns (default): Standard CGNS (NGON/NFACE) for ParaView. gd_cgns: for Fluxcore/Studio, always kept for viewing and simulation. fluent: polyhedral .msh. openfoam: polyMesh. Keep the user's choice; never ask for one.

idempotency_key.description: Use a fresh unique key for each new job, even with identical inputs or a matching finished job. Reuse it unchanged only to retry or resume that same intended job, an uncertain submission included.

notify_url.description: Optional public HTTPS URL sent a signed notification when the job finishes, so you need not poll.

reviewed_job_id.description: A new attempt the user asked for after reviewing this finished mesh job, failures included. Needs a fresh idempotency key; records lineage, never restarts the old run.
